name: webrisp
description: The fastest, zero-bloat React framework. No Vite, No Next.js, No Hono.

scripts.build: npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external --outfile=dist/index.js && npx esbuild src/client.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external --outfile=dist/client.js && npx esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external --outfile=dist/cli.js && cd example-app && npm install && npm run build
